title: Real Money Plugin
description: This plugin allows you to have an economy in your server
body:
💰 **RealMoney v0.0.2**
Take your server's economy to the next level with realistic physical items!

RealMoney is a lightweight yet powerful plugin designed for servers seeking a tangible economy. Forget abstract numbers on a balance sheet; let your players hold, trade, and accumulate wealth with custom coins and coin stacks.

✨ **Key Features:**
Custom Physical Items: Introduce "Coins" and "Coin Stacks" with unique textures.

Anti-Exploit Protection:
Building Block: Prevents players from placing coins as if they were gold blocks.
Crafting Security: Blocks the use of coins at the crafting table to prevent them from being turned into other items.
Safe Trading: Special protection to prevent accidental trades with Villagers.

Resource pack: https://download.mc-packs.net/pack/65b4d3ca68f71afb46654a4b0de04afa180ad8bb.zip
(If you want to add it to your own resource pack)

**The main command is:**
/realmoney give coin/stack <player> <amount>
